notes.title: 2 New Weapons!
notes.content:
2 new weapons are now available in Arsenal Online, including a new [b]Super Weapon[/b]!

[h2]TVR Barricade[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44713803/6385248d143cdf5e1aa261bc7f326f6bf5ecd03a.png[/img]
SMG with a high rate of fire

[h2]ETAS-12[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44713803/4d25764b08f4a91512f85c1e40de593adb32b456.png[/img]
Super Weapon shotgun with high damage

Remember you can automatically unlock all Super Weapons with the [b]Super Weapons Pack[/b]:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2752320/Arsenal_Online_Super_Weapons_Pack/

[h1]Other Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Minor UI updates
[*] Updated SFX
[/list]
